description: For each date, tell whether it is a public holiday in the country (with its name and status), a weekend, and a business day, including make-up working days such as China's 调休. Also returns today in that country's time zone. For Japan, the kind is also given: 祝日 (national holiday) / 振替休日 (substitute holiday) / 国民の休日 (citizens' holiday).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, DE, CN, JP). Defaults to JP (Japan) when omitted.

include_government.description: Outside Japan: also treat days off only for government offices (e.g. Indonesia's cuti bersama, Canadian federal holidays) as days off.

region.description: Outside Japan: state/province code (ISO 3166-2 suffix, e.g. CA for California) to include regional holidays.

year_end_closed.description: Japan only: treat 12/29-1/3 as non-business days (common in Japanese companies).

name: check_dates
title: Check dates
